University of Maryland suspends tennis club over racist imagery allegations

The University of Maryland has suspended its club tennis team following allegations that members distributed racist imagery. The university confirmed the suspension, stating that the team's activities have been halted. The specific nature of the imagery and the exact circumstances of its distribution were not detailed in the reports.
